event.title: Excavating a Legacy: Dr. Kathleen Deagan
event.description: Explore the free Excavating a Legacy exhibition on Marston Science Library’s second floor. Discover Dr. Kathleen Deagan’s archaeology career through historical artifacts, publications, letters, and oral-history excerpts. The exhibition runs August 20–December 18, 2026. Today’s quest check-in window is October 18, 10 AM–6 PM Eastern. One 25 XP completion per person for the entire exhibition; refreshing the board does not reset eligibility.
